en.title: A little about me
paragraphs: I’m building Bloomtrade and SupWallet. AiFi Talk is where I share the decisions, experiments, and lessons behind the work.
I explore AI and finance by building products and testing ideas. Writing helps me explain what I tried, what happened, and what I learned.
I want to make AI and finance easier to understand through something you can inspect, try, or build yourself.

zh-Hant.title: 關於我
zh-Hant.greeting:
我是 Frederic。
先動手做，再寫下來。
paragraphs: 我正在做 Bloomtrade 和 SupWallet。在 AiFi Talk，我會分享過程中的決策、實驗，以及學到的事。
我透過做產品、測試想法來探索 AI 與金融，並把過程中的心得寫下來。
我希望透過能仔細看、親手試，甚至自己做出來的東西，讓 AI 和金融更容易理解。
